text: Jonathan Evison's Lawn Boy was removed from high school libraries by Fairfax County Public Schools in Virginia, after speakers at a school board meeting denounced the book for sexually explicit language, scenes and imagery. A committee reviewed a request to reconsider the book and its inclusion in FCPS libraries on October 27, 2021.
